newer_changes_search: Web search (tribal.nic.in, PIB, Lok Sabha replies, press) for 2025-2026 changes: an August 2025 report says the Centre is considering revising parental income limits for SC/ST scholarships for FY 2026-27 to 2030-31, with MoTA proposing Rs 4.5 lakh for ST; I found no notification or Cabinet approval, so Rs 2.5 lakh still applies. No discontinuation found; the MoTA scholarship page (snapshot) still describes the scheme. Guideline period (2021-22 to 2025-26) has ended without published successor; treated as minor.

findings.note: <= 250000 matches 'should not exceed Rs.2.50 lakhs per annum'. A proposal to raise the ST limit to Rs 4.5 lakh for 2026-31 is pending.
findings.suggestion: Watch tribal.nic.in / PIB; update rule and fixtures if notified.

findings.note: The quote ('disbursement of scholarship to eligible ST students ...') supports the ST requirement only indirectly. Acceptable; the scheme name itself is 'for ST students'.
findings.suggestion: Optional: cite the MoTA Post-Matric guideline PDF linked from the same page for a direct eligibility clause (and use 'confirmed').

findings.note: content.en has no note that the guideline period ended in March 2026, unlike the SC/OBC files. Maintenance Rs 230-1,200/month matches the MoTA page.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add 'check the portal for this year's rules' to how_to_apply for consistency.

findings.note: caste_certificate, income_certificate, marksheet, aadhaar, bank_account all cite the MoTA page, which lists none of them (only DBT to bank accounts and a UIDAI Aadhaar notification link). They are plausible.
findings.suggestion: Cite the MoTA post-matric guideline PDF for the document list.
